entities.summary: Edgar Wind was a British interdisciplinary art historian, specializing in iconology in the Renaissance era. He was a member of the school of art historians associated with Aby Warburg and the Warburg Institute as well as the first Professor of art history at Oxford University. Edgar Wind was a architects & designers from Berlin (1900-05-14, Berlin–1971-09-12). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
